reason: Both identify the identical root cause: sanitize_label's None-guard uses a bare `return` (implicitly returning None) instead of `return \"\"`, violating the -> str contract. Both also identify the identical downstream symptom: a caller (export.py) passes a None label into html.escape(), which raises AttributeError since None lacks a .replace method. The reviewer even specifies the exact call site (export.py:369, the label rendering path) and confirms via direct execution, matching the ground truth's own scenario (community-legend label rendering). This is the same defect, not a paraphrase of a different one.
